::: {#thm-sample-mean-expectation}

#### The expectation of a sample average

Let $\dsn{X}$ be random variables, with $n \ge 1$, that each have finite mean $\mean$,
and let $\bar X \eqdef \avgin X_i$.
The $X_i$ need not be independent.
Then

$$\Ep[\bar X] = \mean$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-linearity-use, worked in @sol-linearity-use.
It follows from @thm-linearity-expectation, which needs no independence
and applies because each $\Ep[X_i] = \mean$ is finite.

:::
